title: HelperSSHPromptResult
description: What a person answered, positionally matched to the challenge's questions. Position rather than a key or a label, because that is what keyboard-interactive IS: the protocol answers a challenge's list in order, and a mapping would be a second spelling of an order the protocol already fixes. The count is the helper's to check — a shorter list means the library would answer the missing questions with empty strings, i.e. try an empty password — and a coordinator that cannot answer refuses by name instead of answering with nothing.

answers.description: One answer per question, in the order the questions were asked. The values are secret material in transit and are never logged, stored or returned by the helper.
